review_evidence: README identifies LeanML as a Mathlib-based formal verification project for machine-learning algorithms, with foundations, loss/optimization material, and verified linear-regression optimality results.
The 17 primary Lean files include 12 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations across four proposition-bearing modules, alongside the definitions and interfaces those results depend on.

Direct inspection of Regression/Linear/Origin.lean shows formal definitions of Sxx, Sxy, least-squares loss and aStar together with proved nonnegativity, normal-equation, loss-decomposition, and global-minimization theorems; the test files exercise these formal interfaces and no lossless noise class was established.
summary: Retain LeanML as a substantive formalization of machine-learning definitions and verified regression results.

review_evidence: LeanML/Foundations/Losses/Basic.lean defines residual, empiricalLoss, meanLoss and proves empiricalLoss_nonneg by Finset induction.
LeanML/Foundations/MetricSpaces.lean defines metricLoss, squaredMetricLoss, empirical sums, normDistance, and proves nonnegativity, self, symmetry, triangle, and normDistance_eq_dist lemmas.
LeanML/Foundations/NormedSpaces.lean defines normLoss and squaredNormLoss and proves their equality to the metric losses plus nonneg, self, comm, and triangle lemmas.
LeanML/Foundations/VectorSpaces.lean defines linearCombination and centroid over a module / real normed space and proves additivity and zero lemmas.
LeanML/Foundations.lean has six imports of Foundations submodules and nothing else; it is an import-only aggregator retained under FILTER-007.
LeanMLTests.lean has five imports of LeanMLTests submodules and nothing else; it is an import-only aggregator retained under FILTER-007.
LeanMLTests/Affine.lean and LeanMLTests/Origin.lean import the linear regression modules, open their namespaces, and #check Sxx, Sxy, aStar, bStar, loss, optimal_minimizes, aStar_minimizes.
LeanMLTests/MetricSpaces.lean, NormedSpaces.lean, VectorSpaces.lean open the foundations namespaces and #check the defined losses, centroid, and triangle / compatibility lemmas.
summary: Read all 11 files of the unit in full. The five LeanML/Foundations modules define machine-learning losses, metric and norm distances, linear combinations and centroids, with proved lemmas (nonnegativity, symmetry, triangle inequality, additivity). The two root files are import-only aggregators, which stay primary-eligible under FILTER-007 because no end-to-end auxiliary navigation channel is established. The five LeanMLTests files hold imports, a namespace open, and #check commands that name the library API; they have no declarations, but they are API navigation for the regression and foundations modules, and no auxiliary channel that keeps that navigation is established, so FILTER-004 is not met. Default disposition: retain all files; no exclusions.
